output.summary: A mostly annual vine originating in western South America, the tomato bears an edible berry eaten as a vegetable. Its thousands of cultivars differ greatly in size, colour, shape and flavour, while breeding for uniform red ripening has reduced sweetness and flavour.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is eaten as a vegetable and used in sauces, soups, salads, condiments, curries, juice and other drinks.
